name: Neural Vector Quantization
definition: A quantization technique that quantizes 3D Gaussian parameters grouped by K-means and compresses distilled SH features using lightweight neural decoders to minimize storage costs.
summary: Neural Vector Quantization compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting by partitioning attributes into sub-vectors with separate codebooks and using neural decoders for spherical harmonics, reducing storage while mitigating codeword collisions.
